## Frost et al. (2023), Vinet

`palladium_frost_2023_vinet_1` · Explicit diagnostic selection; not recommended

Reproduction: **close** · [Reconstruction report](../reconstruction-reports/palladium.md#record-palladium_frost_2023_vinet_1)

**Warning:** Not recommended for quantitative use. Default selection on hold pending review. Never chosen automatically; select it explicitly. The authors' fitting objective and covariance convention are unstated, so the published fit is not fully reproduced.

**Source finding:** The paper reports three hydrogen-free Pd-in-neon runs to 182 GPa and fits both Vinet and BM3 forms using pressure and volume uncertainties. Supplementary Tables I-III provide all 93 sample observations; Runs 1 and 2 use tungsten pressure markers and Run 3 uses gold.

| Component | Parameter | Value | Reported error | Fixed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Primary | V0 | 58.678 | 0.073 | Not listed |
| Primary | K0 | 189.3 | 3.0 | Not listed |
| Primary | K0\_prime | 5.473 | 0.063 | Not listed |

- **Reproduction status:** not\_reproduced
- **Fit reproduction status:** not\_reproduced
- **Origin of the parameterization:** experimental
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Frost; Smith; McBride; Smith; Glenzer
    - **Year:** 2023
    - **Title:** The equations of state of statically compressed palladium and rhodium
    - **Source:** J. Appl. Phys.
    - **Volume:** 134
    - **Locator:** 035901
    - **DOI:** 10.1063/5.0161038
- **Reference temperature (K):** 300.0
- **Reported pressure coverage (GPa):** \[0.0, 182.0\]
- **Coverage provenance:** reported\_exactly

Room-temperature Vinet fit to three hydrogen-free fcc-Pd loadings compressed in neon in a DAC. V0 is an extrapolated fit coefficient, below the separately reported ambient a = 3.8909(1) Å (V = 58.9047 Å³). The paper does not state the fitting objective or covariance convention, so the published fit is not fully reproduced.

<details markdown="1">
<summary>Source review</summary>

- **Note:** Equation, published coefficients, units and all observations are source-checked against the final article and supplement. The original fit protocol is not fully recovered; uncertainty agreement depends on the assumed covariance convention. The record remains not\_reproduced pending protocol clarification, rather than a demonstrated failure of the authors' full protocol.
- **Audit date:** 2026-09-04
- **Verified fields:** equation; parameters; units; reference\_state; phase; published\_uncertainties; validity
- **Primary source check:**
    - **Access URL:** https://doi.org/10.1063/5.0161038
    - **Locations:** Abstract; Methods, page 035901-2; Table I; Figure 1 and caption; Results and discussion; Data availability; Supplementary Section II.A and Tables I-III
    - **DOI:** 10.1063/5.0161038
- **Primary data check:**
    - **Status:** bundled
    - **Audit date:** 2026-09-04
    - **Dataset identifiers:** palladium\_frost\_2023\_tables\_i\_iii\_compression
    - **Source locations:** Supplementary Section II.A; Supplementary Tables I-III
    - **Finding:** All 93 hydrogen-free Pd-in-neon observations are bundled: 26 BX18 rows, 20 BX32 rows, and 47 high-pressure rows. Cell volumes and uncertainties are propagated exactly from the tabulated cubic lattice parameters.
- **Source equation status:** reproduced
- **Recommendation date:** 2026-10-17
- **Recommendation audit:** docs/literature-reproductions/palladium-frost-2023-audit.md
- **Recommendation reason:** The original author regression remains unrecovered. The final paper specifies uncertainty-aware Marquardt-Levenberg fitting but not the exact objective, ambient-point inclusion, constraints or covariance convention. Independent refits have similar central coefficients; the combined-two-width comparison fails with absolute-error covariance and passes with residual-scaled covariance. This is not a demonstrated failed replay of the author protocol. Quantitative recommendation and the default remain on hold pending clarification.
- **Fit audit date:** 2026-10-17

</details>

Independent refits have similar central coefficients; the combined-two-width comparison fails with absolute-error covariance and passes with residual-scaled covariance. This is not a demonstrated failed replay of the author protocol. Quantitative recommendation and the default remain on hold pending clarification.

### palladium\_frost\_2023\_tables\_i\_iii\_compression

- **Description:** All 93 hydrogen-free room-temperature Pd-in-neon compression observations from supplementary Tables I-III: 26 BX18 rows, 20 BX32 rows, and 47 high-pressure rows.
- **Kind:** pressure\_volume
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Frost; Smith; McBride; Smith; Glenzer
    - **Year:** 2023
    - **Source:** J. Appl. Phys.
    - **Volume:** 134
    - **Locator:** 035901
    - **DOI:** 10.1063/5.0161038
- **Source location:** Supplementary Section II.A, Tables I-III
- **Associated EOS records:** palladium\_frost\_2023\_vinet\_1; palladium\_frost\_2023\_bm3\_2
- **Uncertainty:**
    - **Pressure error gpa:** 0.1
    - **Volume error propagation:** sigma\_V = 3 \* a^2 \* sigma\_a for the cubic conventional cell
    - **Source location:** Main article Methods and supplementary Tables I-III
- **Notes:** The independent ambient powder value a=3.89088(2) A is reported separately from Tables I-III and is not included in this 93-row fit dataset. BX18 and BX32 use tungsten pressure markers; the high-pressure loading uses gold.
